_meta.built: 2026-11-10 from build/pos-work (not committed: uses local LSJ XML, the Cambridge lexicon text and a Morpheus build from github.com/johnhboyer-sys/morpheus)
_meta.note: An empty list means no source states a class: the reading gets no part of speech.
_meta.raw_readings: 240 lemmata seen only in readings the pipeline drops from the popup (implausible readings such as ἡμός, Doric ἡδονά) are classed by the same order: verb when Morpheus parses a verb form; else LSJ when exactly one entry matches; else the Cambridge lexicon; else Morpheus.
_meta.rule: John 2026-11-10: the class LSJ states for the entry the word popup links; if LSJ states none, the Cambridge Greek Lexicon's; else Morpheus's own (V/P code, stem type, or indeclinable tag). A reading Morpheus parses as a verb form is a verb; an uninflected reading is never a verb. ἄλλος and ἔνιοι are both adj and pronoun (John).
_meta.what: Part of speech per Morpheus reading: lemma -> {"*": default classes, "<parse>": classes for that parse}.
